note: Az angol morfológiája szegény, ezért a ragozas kérdések a legtöbb, ami még őszinte: többes szám (release/releases, contract/contracts, migration/migrations, copy/copies), személyrag (expires/expire, stays/stay) és -ly képző (night/nightly). Egy helyen szándékosan törik a 6 karakteres prefix: copy -> copies, ahol az y -> ie váltás miatt a közös előtag csak 3 karakter. A többi pár végig tartja a prefixet, mert az angol toldalékolás kizárólag hátul történik.

docs.text: Cutting a release takes the `bun run release` command. CI only fires on the main branch, nowhere else.
The customer contract expires in December 2026. The renewal has to be discussed already in November.
The Redis connection comes from the RATE_LIMIT_URL environment variable. Without it the service dies at startup.
Design feedback: the button contrast is far too weak in dark mode.
Ticket PROJ-4412 says the billing module rounds discounts wrong.
Every migration needs a working down step as well, because that is the only way back on production.
The database backup kicks off every night at two, and each copy stays available for seven days.
The frontend team renders every data table with TanStack Table.
The client explicitly asked for the reports in PDF, not in Excel.
The staging password lives in the password manager, never in the repo.
A failed login throws ECONNREFUSED when the auth service is down.
The daily standup is at nine in the morning, local time, over video.
